address_density.meaning: Address points per km2 (OpenAddresses county/state sources), 3x3-cell smoothed; unknown where no source covers the county

canopy_pct.meaning: Tree canopy cover of the cell (NLCD / USFS Tree Canopy Cover 2021)

cropland_class.meaning: Most common USDA Cropland Data Layer class in the cell (1 corn, 5 soybeans, 24 winter wheat, 36 alfalfa, 37 other hay, 61 fallow, 111 water, 121-124 developed, 141-143 forest, 176 grass/pasture)

flood_zone.meaning: Highest FEMA flood class in the cell: 0 minimal (zone X), 1 0.2% annual chance, 2 1% annual chance (A, AE, AH, AO), 3 regulatory floodway, 4 coastal high hazard (V, VE); unknown where unmapped or zone D

housing_density.meaning: Housing units per km2 (2020 Census blocks)

impervious_pct.meaning: Impervious surface share of the cell (NLCD 2021)

median_year_built.meaning: Median year the homes were built (ACS 5-year B25035, block group); 1939 means 1939 or earlier

night_lights.meaning: Relative night-time brightness, 0 dark to 1 brightest (NASA Black Marble 2016, VIIRS DNB; tone-mapped image, saturates in city cores; not radiance)

noise_db.meaning: Loudest modelled road-noise class within the cell, as the class floor in dB (BTS National Transportation Noise Map 2020, roads); 40 means below the map's 45 dB floor

park_unit.meaning: National Park Service unit the cell is in: 0 none, else an index into the bundle's park table

addresses.by: OpenAddresses contributors and the source counties/states
addresses.licence: Per source (mostly public domain or CC-BY/CC0); counts only are kept
addresses.name: OpenAddresses (county and state address points)

cdl.by: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (via Microsoft Planetary Computer)
cdl.name: Cropland Data Layer

census.name: 2020 Census blocks (TIGER/Line, POP20, HOUSING20); ACS 5-year B25035 median year built

fars.by: US DOT National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
fars.name: Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS)

flood.name: National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL), flood hazard zones

hpms.by: US DOT Federal Highway Administration and the state DOTs
hpms.name: Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS), full extent

night.name: Black Marble 2016 (VIIRS Day/Night Band) via GIBS

nlcd.name: NLCD 2021 Impervious Surface; NLCD/USFS Tree Canopy Cover 2021 (v2021-4)

noise.by: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics
noise.name: National Transportation Noise Map 2020 (road)

parks.name: NPS unit boundaries; NPS visitor use statistics
